description: All six operator sets on the same 50 objects, graded together: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 at high (medium requested, served as high) and at max reasoning effort and Kimi-K3.1-Pro (Codex CLI), and the paper's Claude Haiku, Sonnet and Opus batches (Claude Code); six agents A-F, 300 simulations per evaluator, three Fable evaluators (scripts/run_fable.sh) and three Astra evaluators (scripts/run_astra.sh) reading the same self-contained packets.

models.effort_note: Run with --effort medium (metrics.json effort 'medium'), which DeepSeek serves as high (user, 2026-11-19; experiments/agentic_batch/codex_models.json effort_served), so this is a high-effort batch. The key 'deepseek' and the batch folder keep their names.

models.note: The paper round's batch (graded there too): the same 50 runs and the exact category figures the paper-round evaluators saw, copied from its packets (output/agentic_object_record/model_eval/packet_k/figures).

label_seed_note: 2198 is the first seed from 2026 on that gives each model one early (A/B), one middle (C/D) and one late (E/F) label over the three evaluators (deepseek B/E/C, deepseek_max C/B/E, kimi D/F/A, haiku A/D/F, sonnet E/A/D, opus F/C/B for k = 1, 2, 3): evaluators grade in label order, so no model is always graded early or always late, when an evaluator is freshest or most tired.
figures_note: Staged copies of the category figures: the open-weight sets built by illustrations/agentic_results/ar_categories.py (Kimi 2026-11-18, both DeepSeek batches 2026-11-19); Haiku, Sonnet and Opus the exact figures of the paper round's packets (the Opus figures in illustrations/ were rebuilt after that grading and are not used).

fable.model_note: Not pinned (user, 2026-11-19): the runner passes Claude Code's `fable` alias, which serves the current Fable; on 2026-11-19 it resolved to claude-fable-5-2 (the paper's evaluators ran claude-fable-5-1). Each run's init event and transcript record the model it was served.

astra.title: GPT-6-Astra, high effort
astra.harness: Codex CLI (codex exec) in bubblewrap, scripts/run_astra.sh

cost_note: Cost: metrics.json cost_usd of each run. For the Claude Code runs (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus) that is the CLI's total_cost_usd at API prices; for the Codex runs it is the batch runner's price from the token counts with its dated price table, not a billed amount. n/p: no price for that run (left out of the totals and the mean); the FEM workflow's own API calls are excluded.
